# Breaking: When it comes to generative AI, the bump from rehiring Jensen doesn’t appear to be holding

### And Anthropic has dropped below its IPO price

Gary Marcus

Nov 24, 2026

Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall. Humpty Dumpty had a great fall. All the king's horses and all the king's men Couldn't put Humpty together again.

[Keeping this brief, because I have something else urgent that I want to cover, too.]

In the opinion of many, including both Democratic and Republican members of Congress, President Trump sacrificed the integrity of the Oval Office in order to prop up the AI industry and his own holdings.

Whatever he did, it doesn’t look like the enthusiasm for Jensen’s return has lasted long*. Monday brought a bounce; thus far Tuesday has brought this:
